name: waypoint-api-gateway
description: waypoint-api-gateway tooling: 14 wp-gw-* agents (public route, aggregate, auth, public-endpoint, internal client and rate-limit builders plus read-only contract, security, performance and architecture reviewers, plus a .github maintainer), 15 /wp-* commands, 10 path-scoped rules, 13 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a waypoint-api-gateway checkout.
